text: Outcome: no stale owned overlays or retained presentation bindings. Policy: theme/density changes dismiss menus/tooltips and cancel ghosts; reopen resolves current public styles. Scope: scoped root styles, explicit host root binding, scene/window listener ownership, renderer/overlay disposal and synthetic tests; no model/schema/runtime/pin changes. Preserve S1/S2 dirty source and pane lifetime semantics. Window hide closes transients/floating presentation; explicit Dock.dispose releases the dock's bindings/panes; scene/window transfer detaches old owners. Evidence: computed colors, open/change/reopen/close, repeated bind/unbind and owner/dispose cycles, all FX suites on22/24 and25/27 plus timed native scenes. Next: implement scoped resources and cleanup, then verify actual public popup skins.
